analog.dispatch_condition: phase1/analog/analog_block_list.json or L5_ADI_SPEC.json makes the analog track applicable
analog.scheduling: The top-level runner dispatches the dedicated A1-A9 runner; the analog runner owns the A-track step programs and reports.

mixed_signal.scheduling: M1-M4 are declared mixed-signal flow steps. Current M1 producer dispatch is in the top-level all-flow runner after analog and Phase 3; phase3 and phase23 entry runners do not dispatch it.

m1.certification: The producer is advisory; mixed_signal_merge_check is the blocking verdict and must consume real producer evidence.

m2.known_gap: no program in this plugin writes M2's required_outputs; closing this needs a real emitter that reads the UPF and the post-PnR netlist for INSERTED protection cells — an owner decision, not a declaration edit
m2.evidence_policy: The checkers must not manufacture empty evidence.

reports/analog/mixed_signal/interface_si.owner: mixed_signal_interface_si_check is checker-only; no production writer exists

m3.known_gap: A9 produces mixed_signal_results.json only. M3 remains PARTIAL/CANNOT_CERTIFY until a real interface-SI producer owns interface_si.json.
m3.evidence_policy: The checker must not manufacture interface_si.json or empty evidence.

reports/analog/mixed_signal/signoff.json.owner: mixed_signal_signoff_check consumes signoff.json as producer input; no production writer exists

m4.known_gap: M4 cannot certify until a real mixed-signal sign-off producer owns signoff.json; the checker must not manufacture it.
m4.evidence_policy: The checker must not manufacture signoff.json or empty evidence.
